messages.subject: using geom_hline
parts:
Hi,

I developed a barchart (four bars) showing the probability of a customer
taking a particular service. The length of each bar is the probability
under a different condition. The chart is rotated using coord_flip
(bars horizontal) for a better appearance. I also calculated the take
probability under a base condition that I would like to show as a line
on the same chart. For this, I used geom_hline(yintercept = base) where
base is the base probability. The line should be vertical cutting
across all four horizontal bars. With the bars going horizontally, the
line however only goes as far as the first bar, then stops. If I don't
flip the bars so that they go vertically, the line goes across the four
bars. I want the bars to be horizontal and the line to go vertically
across all four bars. How? And why does it stop at the first bar when
the bars are horizontal?

Thanks,

Walt
